page.layout: One page of running text in one column, with a head at the top across the full width ("EIRENICI" over "PARS PRIMA."). A large woodcut initial N opens the text. No margin notes. Catchword "tam" at the lower right, signature "A 5" at the lower left.

main_text.head: EIRENICI PARS PRIMA.
main_text.p: NATURALE studium est omniumi ut fruantur bono; & ad fructum boni consequendum depellunt à se contraria naturæ luce, quibus oppugnatur bonum. Hunc autem appetitum, qui rebus omnibus naturalis est, multa insuper accidētia solent acuere; inprimis autem molestæ malorum infestantiū moles & fluctus procellarum: qui quo grauius impendent atque exagitant, eo plus animi humani premuntur sollicitudine. Ac sollicitudo quidem de proprio & singulari bono ita est singulis indita, ut moneri quemquam non sit opus de bonis singularibus & privatis cōmodis persequendis, aut propulsandis incommodis. Sed cùm à natura ita fit comparatum, ut singula quæque ad unum aliquod commune bonum referantur, homines verò supra res creatas cæteras per singularem Dei gratiam luce rationis, & quàm plurimis ad bonum adiumentis instructi sint: quod indignum aliis rebus existimát, eas à bono cōmuni discedere, id multo amplius de se ipsi debent statuere: qui & bono proprio instructi, & ad commune documentis tam multis provocati, tam

page.notes: Page number and running head are not printed. The woodcut initial N is joined to "ATVRALE" as "NATURALE". Printed text reads "omniumi" and "accidētia" with some doubt about the macron and the vowel; the scan is low-resolution there, so these are not marked with [?]. "fruftum" was read as "fructum" (long s/ct ligature). "fandis" was read as "sandis" from "propulsandis". Word "tam" at the foot is the catchword, and the text is carried over to the next page.
